composition.title: Garage Disco Dub Break
form: A, bars 1-8: the gospel IV-iii-ii-V groove; rootless FM electric-piano chords with pushed syncopation, deep round triangle bass holding roots with octave answers, four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, sixteenth hats and offbeat open hat; the pulse lead sings a short call; clap fill in bar 8.

B, bars 9-16: a gospel progression (Abmaj9-C7b9-Fm9, Ebm9-Ab13 into Dbmaj9 and the minor-iv Dbm6, Cm9-F7b9 turnaround); phased supersaw strings enter, the piano holds longer chords, the bass pushes harder and the lead answers fuller; clap roll in bar 16.

A', bars 17-24: the dub breakdown on the A changes: kick and open hat drop out, the bass plays long tones with sparse octave answers, single piano stabs and one clap per bar echo through heavy dotted-eighth delay, lead fragments echo; then the rebuild: kick on one (19-20), on one and three (21-22), full from 23, the A groove back from 21 and a clap roll in 24.

C, bars 25-32: the full groove returns on new changes (Fm9-Dbmaj9-Eb9sus4-Abmaj9/Ab9, Dbmaj9-Dbm6, Cm9 F7b9, Bbm9 Eb9sus4) with strings, the busiest piano and the lead hook at its peak (c6-db6-eb6); clap roll and Eb9sus4 turnaround into bar 1.
composition.motif: A gospel call: a two-eighth pickup ab4-c5 rising to a held eb5 and a reach to f5, answered by a falling eb5-c5-bb4 sigh; the break chops it into echoing fragments, and C lifts it to the high ninth and eleventh.
composition.intent: New York garage disco idioms: deep, warm, round bass (FM-tinged triangle) holding roots with octave answers; gospel-ish rootless electric-piano voicings (major and minor ninths, suspended ninths, minor-iv Dbm6, altered dominants) in pushed syncopation; four-on-the-floor kick with clap on 2 and 4, sixteenth hats and an offbeat open hat; a dub-style breakdown where kick, open hat and most layers drop out while delay echoes the piano stabs, claps and lead fragments, then a step-by-step rebuild; phased supersaw strings only in B and C; a soulful pulse lead with vibrato. Soulful and spacious at library level.
